prompt: Design a modular Distributed Object Storage Service in Python with: (1) HTTP Gateway handling chunked multipart file uploads, (2) Erasure Coding Engine splitting objects into data and parity fragments using Reed-Solomon math, and (3) Metadata Catalog mapping object keys to storage nodes.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Gateway Score: 0-5 (Evaluates large file stream processing)
Module 2 Encoding Score: 0-5 (Evaluates erasure coding fragment distribution)
Module 3 Catalog Score: 0-5 (Evaluates metadata indexing and consistency)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates fault-tolerant object retrieval)
